### THE BEST OF MODERN LIVING WITH LUXURIOUS LAYOUTS AND PANORAMIC VIEWS IN THE HEART OF DOWNTOWN.  

Tower 12 puts you at the epicenter of vibrant downtown living, offering custom studios, one, and two-bedroom apartments, and penthouses with sophisticated architecture and designer finishes. 

[VIEW AMENITIES & FEATURES](https://www.tower12.com/amenities)

## A HIGHER QUALITY OF LIVING

Live in a gorgeous apartment in the center of the Belltown neighborhood with exceptional amenities in a friendly and active atmosphere. Enjoy living within the epitome of the Seattle experience with Pike’s Place Market, award-winning restaurants, and the Westlake Shopping Center steps from your home. 

Tower 12 offers luxurious studio, one and two-bedroom pet-friendly apartments and penthouses that showcase stunning views of downtown and Puget Sound. Your apartment will have superior amenities, like a gourmet kitchen, quartz countertops, A/C, full-size in-unit laundry, and plank hardwood-style flooring. 

Expand your living space with outstanding community amenities, including a rooftop sky lounge, a state-of-the-art fitness center, a theater, a reservable clubhouse, and more. You’ll enjoy connecting with your neighbors at the weekly resident events held by our industry-leading leasing team and concierge.  

![tower12 apartments.](https://lirp.cdn-website.com/c035667c/dms3rep/multi/opt/t12-1920w.png)

### the definition of

## LUXURY

Tower 12 is centrally located between Seattle’s vibrant Belltown and Downtown neighborhoods. You’ll never run out of fun things to do with iconic Seattle venues like Moore Theater, Seattle Center, Climate Pledge Arena, Westlake Shopping Center, and the Seattle waterfront just a quick stroll or monorail ride away. However, if you need to leave downtown, it’s a breeze, with easy access to Highway 99, I-5, and public transit options.  

[VIEW PHOTO GALLERY →](https://www.tower12.com/gallery)
